note: ATV2 inference-pivot redesign, PRE-REGISTERED EXTENSION batch (pools with atv2-inf per ATV2-INFERENCE-PILOT-RESULT.md addendum). Same frozen design spec as the pilot: symmetry-redesigned inference pivot, one per lecture, four next-step options each grounded in a DIFFERENT specific complication, comparably concrete/scoped, self-contained (no sibling-exclusive noun). Inference pivot POSITION varied across lectures (q1 x2, q2 x2, q3 x2, q4 x2) to avoid the fixed-slot mistake caught in-house before freeze. Fresh domains: Toxicology, Metrology, Selenography, Chronobiology, Paleoclimatology, Phenology, Hydrology, Ethnobotany -- none used in pilot, b1-b8 (incl. unfrozen b6-b8 drafts), or atv2-inf.

pivots.stem: What does the professor say the sediment cores from Ferrow Creek showed about toxin concentration over the last decade?
settings: It rose steadily each year, with no year showing a decline
It spiked twice, a decade apart, then returned to baseline both times
It stayed essentially flat, with only minor year-to-year noise
It declined for years, then rose sharply in the most recent samples

pivots.stem: Why does the professor mention the cannery's shipping manifests from the 1950s?
settings: They record a batch of fish rejected for an unusual smell
They show the cannery closed years before anyone suspected contamination
They document a change in where the cannery sourced its catch
They list a fine the cannery paid for a discharge violation

pivots.stem: What does the professor imply the team will do with the new field bioassay kit?
settings: Run it alongside the lab assay for one season to check the two agree
Deploy it at two additional depths within the same monitoring station
Use it to screen samples from three creeks the lab has never covered
Recalibrate it against a certified reference sample before the season starts

pivots.stem: How does the professor respond to the claim that the toxin comes from upstream mine tailings rather than a natural algae bloom?
settings: She doubts it -- the tailings pond drains a different sub-basin entirely
She accepts it, mainly because the toxin's chemical signature matches known tailings compounds
She thinks the question is still open, since neither source has been ruled out by testing so far
She rejects the tailings explanation but allows a smaller natural source may compound it

pivots.stem: What does the professor imply the recalibration team will do with the recovered Harrow ell rod?
